title: Real PHP 5.0.0 (PHP's own main(), 145 translation units) as a Linux process on the virtual profile, one image serving four allocator arms selected at run time by PHP_CAP_MODE
workload: the 31-case population ASAN misses and the 29-case population it sees, each trigger a .php script on stdin, judged by run-realphp.py through bug-corpora/tools/verdicts.py against the corpus's ASAN and pristine records; php -n -v exits 1 as native PHP does and the stock arm's output matches the native glibc build
status: recorded results are from images on the VM-image ABI before dev's v7-only loader; not yet rebuilt or re-run on the merged tree
note: PHP's source tree and the oracle it is scored against (results-asan-default.json, results-asan-stockalloc.json, results-pristine-default.json and the case metadata) are read from an external read-only mount, /corpus, which is not in this repository; there is no bug-corpora/php yet. The Zend allocator seam the protected arms use is ports/php/zend-alloc/sublet.
